sourceDeployment.verification: GitHub branch head and successful Cloudflare build/deployment record checked. The protected proof was run by the owner. Runtime version identity and actual database UUID were not independently queried through the Cloudflare control-plane API.

bindingEvidence.method: Owner-provided Cloudflare screenshots of Production, Previews Base, the recovery branch and the actual feature/legacy-project-readonly source branch. Names were visually checked; configured UUIDs below come from the reviewed branch configs, not a control-plane response.

checks: Standalone revision advances the working part exactly once
Revision 1 retains the complete old part, steps and records
Standard Save overwrites without advancing the revision
An identical revision retry replays the original receipt
Save as revision commits the edited part as Revision 3
Revision 2 retains the previous saved value and named photo explanation
Replacing a drawing leaves its historical file bytes intact
Later instruction and record edits leave the old full snapshot unchanged
Archiving removes active membership without creating a new revision
The archived number remains reserved with different zero padding
Automatic numbering skips the archived part number
Restore retains part and occurrence identities, number and revision level
The archive retains its complete saved context and explanation
The self-contained source backup retains both drawings and the named photo

uploadedBackupVerification.lineEndingEvidence: The uploaded text file has 11 CRLF line endings. Its UTF-8 text with LF line endings matches the browser proof backupSha256. The original uploaded file is retained separately; all embedded file bytes match without modification.
uploadedBackupVerification.method: Local read-only validation of the owner-uploaded backup text: complete trailer, project identity, table counts, all three file IDs, sizes and SHA-256 values match the source report.
